title: FTA IIJA: $56.710 billion obligated and $34.573 billion outlayed remain pre-outcome measures
summary: DOT reports $98.931 billion in adjusted FTA IIJA authority, $56.710 billion obligated, and $34.573 billion outlayed through May 31, 2026. Denominator: Federal Transit Administration IIJA formula and discretionary funding; obligations are 57.3 percent and outlays are 34.9 percent of adjusted authority.
